units.source_text: 葵姬七七佛事都做完了。

en.t: Lady Aoi's forty-ninth-day Buddhist rites had all been completed.

units.source_text: 这七七四十九天之内，源氏公子一直笼闭在左大臣邸内。

en.t: During those forty-nine days, Prince Genji remained shut away in the Minister of the Left's residence.

units.source_text: 头中将现已升任三位中将，知道他不惯闭居，甚是同情，常常陪伴他，为他讲述世间种种见闻，以资安慰。

en.t: To no Chujo, now promoted to Third-Rank Middle Captain, knew that Genji was not used to seclusion and felt deep sympathy for him, so he often kept him company and told him various things he had seen and heard in the world to comfort him.

units.source_text: 重大严肃的事情也有，像往日那样轻薄好色的事情也有。

en.t: Some of the stories were grave and solemn, while others were frivolous and amorous, just as in the old days.

units.source_text: 尤其是关于那个内侍的事，常常取作笑柄。

en.t: In particular, the matter of that Naishi was often made into a joke.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听到他谈内侍，总是劝诫：“哎呀，罪过啊！

en.t: Whenever Prince Genji heard him speak of the Naishi, he would admonish him, "Ah, how sinful!

units.source_text: 不要拿这老祖母来开玩笑！”

en.t: Do not make jokes about that old grandmother!"

units.source_text: 然而每逢谈起，总觉得可笑。

en.t: Yet whenever the subject came up, it always seemed funny.

units.source_text: 他们毫无顾虑，互相纵谈种种偷香窃玉的事情。

en.t: Without the slightest reserve, they freely talked with each other about all sorts of secret love affairs.

units.source_text: 例如那年春天某月十六之夜在常陆亲王邸内相遇之事，

en.t: For example, they spoke of how they had met at Prince Hitachi's residence on the sixteenth night of a certain spring month that year,

units.source_text: 以及秋天源氏公子与末摘花幽会后回宫的早晨被头中将嘲笑的事情等等。

en.t: and of the autumn morning when Prince Genji, returning to the palace after a secret meeting with Suetsumuhana, had been teased by To no Chujo, among other things.

units.source_text: 结果往往是慨叹人世之无常，相与泣下。

en.t: In the end, they would often lament the impermanence of human life and weep together.
